answer.sql:
WITH claim_amounts AS (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Loss_Payment_Amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Loss_Reserve_Amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Expense_Payment_Amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Expense_Reserve_Amount
    FROM claim_amount ca
    LEFT JOIN loss_payment lp ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN loss_reserve lr ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN expense_payment ep ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN expense_reserve er ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = er.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
claim_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        cc.Claim_Identifier,
        pcd.Policy_Identifier
    FROM claim_coverage cc
    JOIN policy_coverage_detail pcd
        ON cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
),
policy_premium AS (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Premium_Amount
    FROM policy_amount pa
    JOIN premium pr ON pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
),
policy_holder AS (
    SELECT
        apr.Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier,
        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT CONCAT_WS(' ', pe.First_Name, pe.Middle_Name, pe.Last_Name), ', ') AS Policy_Holder
    FROM agreement_party_role apr
    LEFT JOIN person pe ON apr.Party_Identifier = pe.Person_Identifier
    WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code = 'PH'
    GROUP BY apr.Agreement_Identifier
),
policy_agent AS (
    SELECT
        apr.Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier,
        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT CONCAT_WS(' ', pe.First_Name, pe.Middle_Name, pe.Last_Name), ', ') AS Agent
    FROM agreement_party_role apr
    LEFT JOIN person pe ON apr.Party_Identifier = pe.Person_Identifier
    WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code = 'AG'
    GROUP BY apr.Agreement_Identifier
)
SELECT
    c.Company_Claim_Number AS Claim_Number,
    p.Policy_Number,
    ph.Policy_Holder,
    pp.Premium_Amount,
    ag.Agent,
    COALESCE(cam.Loss_Payment_Amount, 0) AS Loss_Payment_Amount,
    COALESCE(cam.Loss_Reserve_Amount, 0) AS Loss_Reserve_Amount,
    COALESCE(cam.Expense_Payment_Amount, 0) AS Expense_Payment_Amount,
    COALESCE(cam.Expense_Reserve_Amount, 0) AS Expense_Reserve_Amount
FROM claim c
LEFT JOIN claim_amounts cam ON c.Claim_Identifier = cam.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN claim_policy cp ON c.Claim_Identifier = cp.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy p ON cp.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_premium pp ON p.Policy_Identifier = pp.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_holder ph ON p.Policy_Identifier = ph.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_agent ag ON p.Policy_Identifier = ag.Policy_Identifier
ORDER BY c.Company_Claim_Number, p.Policy_Number;

SELECT p.Policy_Number, apr.Party_Identifier AS Agent_Identifier
FROM policy p
JOIN agreement_party_role apr
  ON p.Policy_Identifier = apr.Agreement_Identifier
WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code = 'AG'
ORDER BY p.Policy_Number, apr.Party_Identifier;

SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    AVG(DATE_DIFF('day', c.Claim_Open_Date, c.Claim_Close_Date)) AS Avg_Days_To_Settle
FROM claim c
JOIN claim_coverage cc
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
JOIN policy_coverage_detail pcd
    ON cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN policy p
    ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
WHERE c.Claim_Open_Date IS NOT NULL
  AND c.Claim_Close_Date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number
ORDER BY p.Policy_Number;

SELECT
  c.Company_Claim_Number,
  SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END)
  + SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END)
  + SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END)
  + SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Total_Loss
FROM claim c
JOIN claim_amount ca ON c.Claim_Identifier = ca.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_payment) lp ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_reserve) lr ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM expense_payment) ep ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM expense_reserve) er ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = er.Claim_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY c.Company_Claim_Number
ORDER BY c.Company_Claim_Number;

SELECT DISTINCT p.Policy_Number, c.Company_Claim_Number
FROM policy p
JOIN policy_coverage_detail pcd ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
JOIN claim_coverage cc ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN claim c ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
ORDER BY p.Policy_Number, c.Company_Claim_Number;

SELECT apr.Party_Identifier AS agent_id,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.Policy_Identifier) AS policies_sold
FROM agreement_party_role apr
JOIN policy p
  ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code = 'AG'
GROUP BY apr.Party_Identifier
ORDER BY policies_sold DESC;

WITH loss_amounts AS (
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_payment
    UNION
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_reserve
    UNION
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM expense_payment
    UNION
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM expense_reserve
),
claim_loss AS (
    SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS Total_Loss
    FROM claim_amount ca
    JOIN loss_amounts la ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = la.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
)
SELECT p.Policy_Number, AVG(cl.Total_Loss) AS Average_Loss
FROM claim_loss cl
JOIN claim_coverage cc ON cl.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
JOIN policy_coverage_detail pcd ON cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN policy p ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number
ORDER BY p.Policy_Number;

SELECT

    cat.Catastrophe_Name,
    p.Policy_Number,

LEFT JOIN claim_coverage cc

LEFT JOIN policy_coverage_detail pcd
    ON cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy p
    ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
GROUP BY
    c.Company_Claim_Number,
    cat.Catastrophe_Name,
    p.Policy_Number

    c.Company_Claim_Number,
    cat.Catastrophe_Name,

WITH policy_losses AS (

),

    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Total_Premium

    JOIN premium pr
        ON pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
)
SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    apr.Party_Identifier AS Agent_Id,
    COALESCE(pl.Total_Loss, 0) / NULLIF(pp.Total_Premium, 0) AS Loss_Ratio
FROM policy p
JOIN agreement_party_role apr
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = apr.Agreement_Identifier
   AND apr.Party_Role_Code = 'AG'
LEFT JOIN policy_losses pl
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = pl.Policy_Identifier

    ON p.Policy_Identifier = pp.Policy_Identifier
ORDER BY p.Policy_Number, Agent_Id;

WITH claim_totals AS (

        SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS loss_reserve_amount,

    LEFT JOIN loss_payment lp ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN loss_reserve lr ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN expense_payment ep ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN expense_reserve er ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = er.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
claim_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        c.Claim_Identifier,
        c.Company_Claim_Number,
        pcd.Policy_Identifier
    FROM claim c
    JOIN claim_coverage cc ON c.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
    JOIN policy_coverage_detail pcd ON cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
),
policy_premium AS (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium_amount
    FROM policy_amount pa
    JOIN premium pr ON pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
),
policy_holder AS (
    SELECT
        apr.Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier,
        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT CAST(apr.Party_Identifier AS VARCHAR), ', ') AS policy_holder_party_identifier,
        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT TRIM(COALESCE(pe.First_Name, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(pe.Last_Name, '')), ', ') AS policy_holder_name
    FROM agreement_party_role apr
    LEFT JOIN person pe ON apr.Party_Identifier = pe.Person_Identifier
    WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code = 'PH'
    GROUP BY apr.Agreement_Identifier
)
SELECT
    cp.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
    p.Policy_Number AS policy_number,
    ph.policy_holder_party_identifier,
    ph.policy_holder_name,
    COALESCE(ct.loss_payment_amount, 0) AS loss_payment_amount,
    COALESCE(ct.loss_reserve_amount, 0) AS loss_reserve_amount,
    COALESCE(ct.expense_payment_amount, 0) AS expense_payment_amount,
    COALESCE(ct.expense_reserve_amount, 0) AS expense_reserve_amount,
    COALESCE(ct.loss_payment_amount, 0)
      + COALESCE(ct.loss_reserve_amount, 0)
      + COALESCE(ct.expense_payment_amount, 0)
      + COALESCE(ct.expense_reserve_amount, 0) AS total_loss,
    COALESCE(pp.premium_amount, 0) AS premium_amount
FROM claim_policy cp
LEFT JOIN claim_totals ct ON cp.Claim_Identifier = ct.Claim_Identifier
JOIN policy p ON cp.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_premium pp ON p.Policy_Identifier = pp.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_holder ph ON p.Policy_Identifier = ph.Policy_Identifier
ORDER BY claim_number, policy_number;

WITH claim_amounts AS (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS loss_payment_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS loss_reserve_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS expense_payment_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS expense_reserve_amount
    FROM claim_amount ca
    LEFT JOIN loss_payment lp ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN loss_reserve lr ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN expense_payment ep ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN expense_reserve er ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
claim_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cc.Claim_Identifier, pcd.Policy_Identifier
    FROM claim_coverage cc
    JOIN policy_coverage_detail pcd
        ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
),
policy_premium AS (
    SELECT pa.Policy_Identifier, SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium_amount
    FROM policy_amount pa
    JOIN premium pr ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
)
SELECT
    c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
    p.Policy_Number AS policy_number,
    CONCAT_WS(' ', per.First_Name, per.Middle_Name, per.Last_Name) AS policy_holder,
    COALESCE(ca.loss_payment_amount, 0) AS loss_payment_amount,
    COALESCE(ca.loss_reserve_amount, 0) AS loss_reserve_amount,
    COALESCE(ca.expense_payment_amount, 0) AS expense_payment_amount,
    COALESCE(ca.expense_reserve_amount, 0) AS expense_reserve_amount,
    COALESCE(pp.premium_amount, 0) AS premium_amount
FROM claim c
LEFT JOIN claim_amounts ca ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN claim_policy cp ON cp.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy p ON p.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN agreement_party_role apr
    ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
   AND apr.Party_Role_Code = 'PH'
LEFT JOIN person per ON per.Person_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_premium pp ON pp.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
ORDER BY claim_number, policy_number;

SELECT
    apr.Party_Identifier AS Agent_Identifier,
    p.Policy_Number,
    c.Company_Claim_Number,
    SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS Loss_Payment_Amount
FROM agreement_party_role apr
JOIN policy p
    ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN policy_coverage_detail pcd
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
JOIN claim_coverage cc
    ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN claim c
    ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN claim_amount ca
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = ca.Claim_Identifier
JOIN loss_payment lp
    ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier
WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code = 'AG'
GROUP BY
    apr.Party_Identifier,
    p.Policy_Number,
    c.Company_Claim_Number
ORDER BY
    apr.Party_Identifier,
    p.Policy_Number,
    c.Company_Claim_Number;

SELECT
  p.Policy_Number,
  pcd.Effective_Date AS Coverage_Effective_Date,
  pcd.Expiration_Date AS Coverage_Expiration_Date,
  SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Premium_Amount
FROM policy_amount pa
JOIN premium pr ON pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier
JOIN policy p ON pa.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN policy_coverage_detail pcd ON pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number, pcd.Effective_Date, pcd.Expiration_Date
ORDER BY p.Policy_Number, pcd.Effective_Date, pcd.Expiration_Date;

SELECT
  p.Policy_Number,
  SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS Total_Loss
FROM policy p
JOIN policy_coverage_detail pcd
  ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
JOIN claim_coverage cc
  ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN claim_amount ca
  ON cc.Claim_Identifier = ca.Claim_Identifier
JOIN (
  SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_payment
  UNION
  SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_reserve
  UNION
  SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM expense_payment
  UNION
  SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM expense_reserve
) la
  ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = la.Claim_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number
ORDER BY p.Policy_Number;

answer.sql:
WITH loss_amounts AS (
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_payment
    UNION ALL
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_reserve
    UNION ALL
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM expense_payment
    UNION ALL
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM expense_reserve
),
policy_losses AS (
    SELECT
        p.Policy_Number,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.Claim_Identifier) AS Number_Of_Claims,
        SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS Total_Loss
    FROM claim c
    JOIN claim_amount ca
        ON c.Claim_Identifier = ca.Claim_Identifier
    JOIN loss_amounts la
        ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = la.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    JOIN claim_coverage cc
        ON c.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
    JOIN policy_coverage_detail pcd
        ON cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
    JOIN policy p
        ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
    GROUP BY p.Policy_Number
),
policy_premiums AS (
    SELECT
        p.Policy_Number,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Premium
    FROM policy_amount pa
    JOIN premium pr
        ON pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    JOIN policy p
        ON pa.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
    GROUP BY p.Policy_Number
)
SELECT
    pl.Policy_Number,
    pp.Premium,
    pl.Number_Of_Claims,
    pl.Total_Loss,
    CAST(pl.Total_Loss AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(pp.Premium, 0) AS Loss_Ratio
FROM policy_losses pl
JOIN policy_premiums pp
    ON pl.Policy_Number = pp.Policy_Number
ORDER BY pl.Policy_Number;

SELECT c.Company_Claim_Number, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS Loss_Payment_Amount
FROM claim c
JOIN claim_amount ca ON c.Claim_Identifier = ca.Claim_Identifier
JOIN loss_payment lp ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY c.Company_Claim_Number
ORDER BY c.Company_Claim_Number;

SELECT
    apr.Party_Identifier AS agent_id,

    c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
    SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS loss_reserve_amount
FROM agreement_party_role apr

    ON p.Policy_Identifier = apr.Agreement_Identifier

    ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN claim_coverage cc
    ON cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN claim c

    ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier

GROUP BY

SELECT
